suggestions: I'm grateful for the aircon finally kicking in on the bus before the humidity got to me.
I'm thankful for the senior dev who merged my PR without fifteen nitpick comments this time.
I'm grateful for a bowl of nasi lemak that didn't disappoint on a rushed lunch break.
I'm thankful for the ten quiet minutes before Subuh when the whole house is still asleep.
I'm grateful my staging environment actually mirrored prod for once and the deploy didn't blow up.
I'm thankful for my mom calling just to check in, not because something's wrong.
I'm grateful for the rain that hit right as I stepped indoors instead of five minutes earlier.
I'm thankful for catching the root cause of that null pointer before standup instead of during it.
I'm grateful for a landlord who actually fixed the leaking pipe the same day I texted him.
I'm thankful for the rezeki of a paycheck that covers rent without me sweating it this month.
I'm grateful for a decent internet connection during a client call after weeks of it dropping.
I'm thankful for my kakak setting aside extra rendang for me when I couldn't make it back for the weekend.
I'm grateful for a full night of sleep before a big sprint review, for once.
I'm thankful for the masjid being just a short walk away, on the days I actually make the effort to go.
I'm grateful for a code review that taught me something instead of just nitpicking semicolons.
